pr_title: Fix leaderboard showing score updates for quit users
pr_body:
The spectator data feed was not unbound if a user quit the room, meaning if they continued to join another room (or play solo) their now incorrect score was still showing up on the leaderboard.

This change unsubscribes and also shows quit users visually (via a tint of their panel to gray).

Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/11308.
pr_comments:
The asssert failing can be fixed by changing the `.Expire` i added to a forced `Remove` then `Dispose` (as below) but this is pretty ugly.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/191335/103166162-b3795400-4862-11eb-839d-55c4135ee167.png)


I don't think there's actually much point in having this assert (and it could also fail of the scoring mode was changed, see `updateAllScores`) so i've opted to just remove it.

issue_context.title: Players are not removed from the leaderboard when leaving the match
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:**

When a player leaves mid match (or during loading), he is not removed from the ingame leaderboard. In addition, if they start playing in singleplayer, score information keeps being updated in the match.

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 

Video shows player "fmpgdev" leaving the lobby right after load and starting a beatmap in singleplayer twice.


https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/22643729/103137835-f0134700-46cc-11eb-85af-eea6ffee3940.mp4
